title: Ep 46 — Cursor and ElevenLabs Wake Up, a National Charger Network Moves Into a Leisure Park, and the AI Song App Doing Seventy-Three Thousand a Month
description: Cursor ships deploy-watching Rollouts and a pull-request Security Review bot, ElevenLabs pulls Sora 2 as OpenAI retires it, Anthropic's agents find a new enzyme system, and RAW Charging puts twenty-two bays into a Wolverhampton leisure park. The build is a TrustMRR-verified AI song generator at seventy-three thousand dollars a month, reworked as end-of-season personalised songs clubs can sell as a fundraiser.
